title: AADP Evidence Module v1.0 — Module schema dispatch
description: The schema URL a manifest's `modules[]` entry points at (specification.md §2). Evidence `1.0` has exactly two top-level document kinds, `claim` and `evidence`, discriminated by their `kind` constants. This schema MUST NOT be used to validate the manifest discovery entry `{id, version, schema}` itself, which is validated by the core manifest schema v1.0.
